scope: Post-soak identity/process/UI observation; display and input fields describe the admitted X9 contract, not a new scanout or touch certification. Recheck identity, PID and ownership before operation.

display.completion: PAN plus same-FB legacy flip event matching request cookie

input.name: gt9xxnew_ts
input.protocol: Type A, tracking IDs, no slots

process.page: Controls, level 68%; image scaling set to 100% by the memory soak; no profile settings changed by this test.
process.console_observation: Console mode was not re-queried during the memory soak; earlier ownership observation is historical.

backup.limitation: Includes full-canvas opaque background caching; before repeated card-image rotation caching.

evidence: evidence/x9-card-cache/2026-10-16/verification.json (local ignored archive, acquired separately); earlier background-cache and renderer-cost records remain in evidence/x9-background-cache/2026-10-16 and evidence/x9-render-cost/2026-10-16.
application_source_note: Runtime source matches library_source. Same verified card-rotation-cache ELF remains running, without injected allocation or flip probes. Current UI and memory observations are recorded in process and memory_soak.

memory_maintenance.scope: ELF archive migration and memory measurements only; original UI observation above was not repeated.
memory_maintenance.method: Ten 1 Hz samples per phase; discard first, median of nine. Sync and POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on the three archive ELFs only; no global drop_caches.
memory_maintenance.preserved: Current executable, font, logs, lock, initial pixels/pan and recovery tool remain at original paths; rollback ELF is persistent with the original path retained as a symlink.
memory_maintenance.verification_limit: No application restart, rollback launch, UI screenshot or display regression in this maintenance; font and recovery materials still reside in tmpfs.

memory_soak.verdict: Not fully stabilized in this run: Controls RSS continued to rise in steps and did not decline during the final two-minute idle. This does not by itself establish a memory leak.
memory_soak.method: Native Slint MCP drives the existing display process; external 1 Hz /proc sampler. No restart, screenshots, allocation probes, trim or manual cache clearing.
